indicator_name: Average monthly nominal wage per employee by region, quarterly
description: Среднемесячная номинальная заработная плата одного работника по регионам, поквартально
methodology: Taldau 702972, period 5 (quarter), 2016 Q1 onward (quarterly from 2015 per BNS; Taldau's quarterly segment starts in 2016). Survey 1-Т, excluding small enterprises (wages including them by size of enterprise: BNS element 520412). National 2026 Q1 461 486, Q2 486 386 KZT.
